text: France: I propose a non-aggression pact. I will hold LON and EDI, supporting LVP to WAL if needed, while you hold PAR and BRE. Let's keep the Channel calm. I am not attacking Belgium or Holland. Please confirm your stance on the Channel and your intentions in the South. - England

Russia: I propose a non-aggression pact. I will hold my fleets in the North Sea and Irish Sea, not attacking Norway or Scotland aggressively. You focus on Germany/Poland. Let's avoid conflict in the North. Please confirm. - England

Germany: I propose a non-aggression pact. I will not attack Belgium or Holland directly this year. I will hold LON/EDI. You focus on Berlin/Munich. Let's keep the North Sea stable. Please confirm. - England

Germany: I am holding in Paris. My fleet in Brest will support London to English Channel. Please hold Munich and Berlin. I propose a mutual non-aggression pact and a draw if we are the last two standing. Let's keep the peace in the center.

England: I am holding Paris. My fleet in Brest supports your fleet to English Channel. This secures your home waters and my coast. Please do not attack Belgium or Picardy. Let's maintain the status quo and focus on other threats.

Italy: I am holding Paris. I have no immediate designs on your borders. If you hold Venice and Rome, I will hold Paris and Marseilles. Let's avoid conflict in the Alps and Pyrenees. A stable Italy allows me to focus on Germany.

France: I propose a mutual hold. I will hold in Munich and Berlin; you hold in Paris and Burgundy. Let's keep the border quiet and focus on our respective theaters (North and South). This secures my flank and yours. Please confirm your intent to hold.

Italy: I propose a mutual hold. I will hold in Munich and Berlin; you hold in Venice and Tyrolia. This secures my southern flank and your northern flank. Let's avoid conflict in the Alps for now. Please confirm your intent to hold.

Russia: I propose a mutual hold. I will hold in Berlin and Munich; you hold in Warsaw and Silesia. This secures my eastern flank. Let's avoid conflict in the center. Please confirm your intent to hold.

Germany: I propose a non-aggression pact. I will hold in StP/Mos and support War to Galicia. You hold Berlin/Mun/Kie. Let's keep the border quiet so we can focus on France and Austria. Please confirm your stance on Germany's border.
Turkey: I suggest we avoid conflict. I will hold my fleets. You hold your armies. If you move to Ankara/Con, I won't interfere. Let's not fight each other. Please confirm.
Austria: I propose we respect each other's spheres. I will not attack Trieste or Budapest. You hold Vienna/Trieste. I focus East. Please confirm.
France: Agreed. I will hold LON and EDI. LVP will move to WAL. This secures the Channel. Please ensure F BRE supports F LON to ENG or holds. Do not attack Belgium. - England
Russia: I hold EDI and LON. LVP moves to WAL. I will not attack Norway. You focus East. - England
Germany: I hold LON/EDI. LVP to WAL. No attack on BEL/HOL. - England
England: Confirmed. I hold PAR. F BRE supports F LON to ENG. This secures the Channel. Please ensure LVP holds or moves to WAL. I will not attack BEL. Let's keep the peace.
Germany: Confirmed. I hold PAR. I expect you to hold MUN and BER. If you move MUN to BUR, I will be forced to react. Please confirm you hold. I will not attack BEL or HOL.
Italy: I hold PAR and MAR. I do not intend to move into VEN or TUS. If you hold VEN and NAP, we can coexist. Please confirm you hold.

France: Agreed to hold. I will hold Berlin and Munich. This secures our mutual border. Please ensure Paris holds and does not move to Burgundy. I will support this hold with Berlin if needed, but for now, let's just hold.
Italy: Agreed to hold. I will hold Munich and Berlin. You hold Venice and Tyrolia. This keeps the Alps quiet. Please confirm you are holding Venice and not moving to Tyrolia or Piedmont.
Russia: Agreed to hold. I will hold Berlin and Munich. You hold Warsaw. Please confirm you are holding Warsaw and not moving to Silesia or Galicia. This secures our eastern border.

England: Agreed to non-aggression. I will hold Berlin and Munich. You hold London and Edinburgh. This keeps the North Sea stable. Please confirm you are holding London and not moving to Yorkshire or Belgium.

Austria: France and Germany have both proposed mutual holds. I accept the hold on Venice/Tyrolia with Germany. Regarding you: I will hold Venice. If you hold Trieste, we are good. If you attack, I will defend. Please confirm you are holding Trieste. I want to avoid a costly war in the Alps. Let's secure the center together.
Germany: I accept your mutual hold. I will hold Venice. This secures our northern borders. Please confirm you are holding Munich and Berlin. I trust this agreement will be honored.
France: I accept your hold. I will hold Rome and Venice. We will respect the Alpine border. Good luck in the west.
Germany: Agreed to mutual hold. I will hold War/Mos/Stp/Sev. You hold Ber/Mun/Kie. This secures our borders. Please confirm you will hold Berlin, Munich, and Kiel.

Agreed. I will hold CON and SMY. My fleet ANK will support CON. Please hold SEV and STP. This secures our border. Do not move fleets into BLA or armies into ARM/UKR. If you hold, I hold. If you attack, I attack.

Italy, I intend to hold my current positions in the East. I have no interest in your Adriatic or Tyrrhenian holdings. If you respect my neutrality, I will respect yours. Let's avoid conflict in the Mediterranean for now.
Confirmed. I hold LON, EDI, and move LVP to WAL. F BRE supports F LON to ENG. This secures the Channel and North Sea. Let's keep the peace. - England

Final confirmation: Germany holds Berlin, Munich, and Kiel. France holds Paris. Italy holds Venice. Russia holds Warsaw. England holds London/Edinburgh. All borders secure. Let's see how the rest of Europe plays out. Good luck.

Germany, I hold VIE. I will not move to BOH. We respect the border. Good.
